sentences.japanese: 君は彼と同じくらい速く泳げますか。
sentences.english: Can you swim as fast as he?

sentences.japanese: 君は彼が泳いでいるのを見たことがありますか。
sentences.english: Have you ever seen him swimming?

sentences.japanese: 君は独りで泳ぎに行ける歳ではない。
sentences.english: You are not old enough to go swimming by yourself.

sentences.japanese: お前は一人で泳ぎに行くにはまだ幼すぎる。
sentences.english: You are not old enough to go swimming by yourself.
